LanguageData.SA_Settings_AllowExplosion: Failed teardown can cause tiny explosions
LanguageData.SA_Settings_EasyModeHint: More fragments, faster work, lower teardown risk, no fire on fail. Still needs research, bench, and real salvage jobs.
LanguageData.SA_Settings_IdleHint: No mechs / no designations - almost idle. Fragments are not research points.
LanguageData.SA_Disabled: Salvage Atlas is disabled in mod settings.
LanguageData.SA_NeedTeardownRank: Unlock Teardown branch rank 1 at the salvage bench first.
LanguageData.SA_BranchMaxed: This atlas branch is fully unlocked.
LanguageData.SA_Designator_Salvage_Desc: Mark mech corpses or ship/mech wrecks for fragment salvage. Crafting colonists strip data shards - not free research points. Analyze at a salvage bench to bank atlas progress.
LanguageData.SA_Designator_Teardown_Desc: Risky teardown of ship chunks / wrecks. Requires Teardown ranks. Failure wastes fragments and may spark fire or a small blast (letter).
LanguageData.SA_Branch_Blueprints_Desc: One-shot schematic prints - decode for a materials package. No permanent global damage.
LanguageData.SA_Branch_FieldKit_Desc: Temporary scrap plating patches on a single colonist.
LanguageData.SA_Branch_Teardown_Desc: Unlock and improve risky wreck teardown recipes.
LanguageData.SA_Branch_Optics_Desc: Temporary jury-rigged optics on one colonist.
LanguageData.SA_Branch_Coolant_Desc: Temporary coolant drip rig for heat comfort on one colonist.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_BP1_Desc: Print a one-shot schematic that decodes into industrial components and steel.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_BP2_Desc: Print a schematic that may decode into a salvaged firearm pattern plus parts.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_BP3_Desc: Print a schematic that decodes into flak-grade protection materials.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_BP4_Desc: Print a high-tier schematic for spacer components and rare metals. Still one-shot.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_FK1_Desc: Enable a short-lived light armor patch on one colonist.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_FK2_Desc: Stronger temporary plating patch (still personal, still temporary).
LanguageData.SA_Rank_FK3_Desc: Best field plating patch - small move penalty, still not a global buff tree.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_TD1_Desc: Unlock teardown designations. Steel and basic components on success.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_TD2_Desc: Teardown can recover plasteel. Slightly better success odds.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_TD3_Desc: Chance at spacer components from wrecks.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_TD4_Desc: Best yields and success chance. Failures still hurt.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_OP1_Desc: Enable a weak temporary aiming patch on one colonist.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_OP3_Desc: Best temporary optics - still personal and timed.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_CL1_Desc: Enable a light temporary heat-comfort rig.
LanguageData.SA_Rank_CL3_Desc: Best temporary heat rig; slight move penalty at full power.
LanguageData.SA_Gizmo_PrintSchematicDesc: Spend one blueprint credit to print a one-shot atlas schematic item.
LanguageData.SA_Gizmo_PatchArmorDesc: Apply a temporary field plating hediff to a nearby / selected colonist. Rank sets strength.
LanguageData.SA_Gizmo_PatchOpticsDesc: Apply temporary optics to a nearby / selected colonist.
LanguageData.SA_Gizmo_PatchCoolantDesc: Apply a temporary coolant comfort rig to a nearby / selected colonist.
LanguageData.SA_Letter_TeardownFailBody: {0} teardown of {1} went wrong. Fragments may have been wasted; check for fire or a small blast.
LanguageData.SA_Msg_NoColonist: No colonist available for the field patch.
LanguageData.SA_Msg_PatchLocked: That field patch is still locked.
LanguageData.SA_Msg_NoSchematicCredit: No schematic credits. Unlock Blueprints ranks first.
